name: DiscoLike
description: DiscoLike company discovery off a proprietary crawl of 70M+ company websites. Find lookalike companies from seed domains or a natural-language ICP. (DiscoLike's richer surface - DiscoGen research, contact search, ICP-fit validation, firmographic enrichment, segmentation - is on its MCP server, which is the feature-complete path; this REST extension covers company discovery so it can run as a RevCode column function.)
author: the upstream workspace (custom)

discover.name: Discover Similar Companies
discover.description: Find companies similar to a seed domain, or matching a natural-language ICP. Bills per company record returned.
discover.instructions: Provide at least one of: domain (a seed company to find lookalikes for), icp_prompt (one-shot natural-language ICP that auto-extracts filters), or icp_text (raw semantic ICP text). country is an ISO-2 code (e.g. US). max_records must be at least 5 (default 100). Page deeper with offset instead of re-running the same query (dedupe by domain across pages). Auth header is x-discolike-key - not Authorization: Bearer, not x-api-key.

domain.description: Seed company domain to find lookalikes for.

icp_prompt.description: One-shot natural-language ICP (auto-extracts structured filters and seed suggestions).

icp_text.description: Raw semantic ICP text (vector search; no auto-extraction).

country.description: ISO-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, AU.

offset.description: Paging offset for net-new rows; dedupe by domain across pages.
